_note: Worked example records showing Claude the expected structure and level of judgement. Fictional: all quoted wording is invented for illustration and is not taken from any standard form.

examples.title: Contractor liability uncapped
examples.description: The amendment deletes the limit on the contractor's total liability, so a single defect or delay event could produce losses far beyond the contract margin.
examples.quote: the Contractor's total liability to the Employer shall not be limited
examples.likelihood_reason: Large claims are uncommon, but the exposure is open-ended when they occur.
examples.impact_reason: A serious defect claim on a project of this type could exceed the whole margin several times over.

examples.title: High delay damages rate
examples.description: Delay damages are set at a weekly rate that is high relative to the contract value, so a modest overrun would erode the margin quickly.
examples.quote: Delay damages: GBP 25,000 per week or part thereof
examples.likelihood_reason: The programme is tight and includes winter groundworks.
examples.impact_reason: Two to ten weeks of overrun is a realistic range on a programme like this.
examples.existing_controls: Damages are capped at 10% of the contract sum.
examples.confidence_reason: The overrun range depends on the bidder's own programme.

examples.title: Ground risk transferred to contractor
examples.description: The contractor is deemed to have satisfied itself about ground conditions, so unforeseen obstructions or poor ground would be at its own cost.
examples.quote: the Contractor shall not be entitled to any additional payment or extension of time arising from the ground conditions
examples.likelihood_reason: The site investigation report is limited to four boreholes on a brownfield site.
examples.impact_reason: Obstructions and contamination on brownfield sites commonly add cost to substructure works.
examples.existing_controls: A site investigation report is provided for information only.
examples.confidence_reason: Depends on the quality of the site investigation.

examples.title: Long payment period
examples.description: Payment falls due well after each valuation date, which strains the bidder's cashflow and increases financing cost.
examples.quote: The period for payment is 60 days after the assessment date
examples.likelihood_reason: This applies to every payment on the contract.
examples.impact_reason: Financing cost of carrying roughly two months of work in progress.

examples.title: Value engineering share
examples.description: The contract lets the contractor propose cheaper alternatives and keep a share of the saving, which could improve margin.
examples.quote: the Contractor's share of any accepted value engineering saving is 50%
examples.likelihood_reason: The specification for external works leaves room for alternatives.
examples.impact_reason: Typical savings from alternative external works materials.
examples.existing_controls: Employer approval is required for each proposal.
examples.confidence_reason: Depends on the employer's willingness to approve alternatives.
